column1: # repeatviz edits.tsv template (tab-separated; lines starting with # are ignored)
# object  = chromosome name (chr1, chrX, ...), or UNPLACED, or REMOVED
# part    = order of the piece in the chromosome (1, 2, 3, ...)
# contig  = contig name exactly as in the assembly FASTA
# start / end = 1-based, inclusive (whole contig: 1 and its length)
# orient  = + (as in the FASTA) or - (reverse complement)
# gap_after = number of N between this piece and the next (e.g. 100); empty for the last piece
# status  = decided or draft (draft chromosomes are labelled in red)

column9: single contig, telomere at both ends
